title: DYOGAS Artifact Envelope
description: Shared wrapper for every DYOGAS artifact instance. Carries identity, lineage, provenance, and tenancy metadata around a type-specific payload. See /artifacts/README.md#6-shared-envelope for full meaning.

artifact_id.description: Stable identity for this artifact's lineage. Immutable for the life of the lineage; never encodes a version. Conventionally prefixed by artifact type (e.g. 'kn-' for Knowledge). See /artifacts/README.md#8-naming-convention.

artifact_version.description: Semver (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) identifying one immutable sealed snapshot of artifact_id. A new version is always a new snapshot, never an in-place edit. See /artifacts/README.md#9-versioning.

artifact_type.description: The artifact's type, matching one of the eight canonical Knowledge Ingestion pipeline artifacts.

run_id.description: Identifier of the pipeline run that produced this artifact version. Stable across every stage of that run.

produced_by.description: Producing agent identity and contract version, formatted as '{agent-name}@{contract_version}'.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at which the Harness sealed this artifact version.

digest.description: Content-addressed hash of the canonicalized payload, used for tamper-evidence and idempotent handoff verification.

tenancy.description: Tenancy scope for this artifact. Cross-tenant references anywhere in the artifact graph are a fail-closed violation.

workspace_id.description: Optional workspace scope within the tenant.

schema_version.description: The payload schema version pinned at emission time. The Harness rejects a handoff if the consumer's pinned compatible range excludes it.

parents.description: Authoritative lineage list of every upstream artifact consumed to produce this one, in addition to any inline *_ref fields inside payload.

artifact_version.description: Sealed version of the parent artifact consumed.

artifact_type.description: Type of the parent artifact, for readability.

payload.description: Artifact-type-specific body, validated against the corresponding schema in /schemas/artifacts.
